description:
I've originally created this repository for testing and to determine if it's still possible to use YouTube on Android 5. I only intended to fix the patches that are essential to have the app running.

When Google started blocking access to YouTube altogether I noticed the only way to keep using the app would be to apply the patches from this repository, so I decided to start fixing all the remaining patches.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed the following patches (they produced an error while patching)
  - `hide-general-ads`
  - `hide-time-and-seekbar`
  - `theme`
  - `default-video-quality`
  - `hide-shorts-component`
  - `return-youtube-dislike`
  - `remove-player-button-background`
  - `overlay-buttons`
  - `hide-firsttime-background-notification`
  - `hide-channel-watermark`
  - `hide-crowdfunding-box`
  - `hide-fullscreen-panels`
  - `hide-autoplay-button`
  - `sponsorblock`

- Properly fixed `enable-minimized-playback`

## Changes

- Merged the commits from upstream

- Disabled the following non-working patches
  - `hide-auto-captions`
  - `hide-create-button`
  - `custom-seekbar-color`
  - `disable-haptic-feedback`
  - `hide-endscreen-cards`
  - `hide-filmstrip-overlay`
  - `hide-info-cards`
  - `hide-mix-playlists`
  - `optimize-resource`
  - `hide-auto-player-popup-panels`
  - `enable-seekbar-tapping`
  - `enable-wide-searchbar`

  Most of these patches will be fixed some time in the future.

- Excluded `sponsorblock` from the default patch selection. The patch itself works but it has issues with the seekbar and voting button.

- Excluded `hide-startup-shorts-player` from the default patch selection because the feature is not present on v16.40.36.

- Replaced references to RVX for Android 6-7

## Known Issues

Please open an issue if you encounter a bug that is not listed here.

- Seekbar thumbnail doesn't appear on livestreams
- Dislikes don't appear on videos (but it does when app version is spoofed to 17.30.34+)
- Opening the video settings menu crashes the app when the app version is spoofed to 17.06.34+
- `switch-create-notification` patch doesn't work as intended
- Cannot close the app when pressing the back button
